subject.title: fix: make design skills compatible with generic updates

question: Should design-system agent skills intentionally update from the moving default branch while runtime CSS stays release-tagged, and what security/upgrade documentation is required before merge?
rationale: The PR changes the trust boundary for distributed agent guidance, and automation should not decide whether mutable main-based skills are an approved exception to the repository's immutable-tag security guidance.

options.title: Document main-based skill updates
options.body: Accept the decoupled skill-update model and update SECURITY.md plus install guidance to state the review, rollback, and pinning expectations before merge.

options.title: Keep immutable skill tags
options.body: Preserve the release-together model and solve generic updater compatibility without making agent guidance follow a mutable branch.

options.title: Hold for upgrade proof
options.body: Pause until maintainers have explicit proof or migration guidance for existing root-router and native-installer users.

recommendation.title: Document main-based skill updates
recommendation.body: Accept the decoupled skill-update model and update SECURITY.md plus install guidance to state the review, rollback, and pinning expectations before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is CODEOWNERS-listed on the affected skill/validation/governance paths and introduced the current router and release contract.
